title: FineBio: A Fine-Grained Video Dataset of Biological Experiments with Hierarchical Annotation

measurement_description: This paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It introduces FineBio, a new fine-grained video dataset of people performing biological experiments, and benchmarks computer vision models on tasks such as step segmentation, atomic operation detection, and object detection within this context.
